overview: Based on the published agenda, the Community Life, Infrastructure and Public Property Committee of Kronenwetter was scheduled to review department reports, consider a temporary moratorium on data center development, discuss an oak wilt ordinance, and examine the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget. The meeting was set to address infrastructure priorities and community development policies for the village.
committee: Community Life, Infrastructure and Public Property (CLIPP) Committee

agenda.item: Approval of July 6, 2026 CLIPP Committee Meeting Minutes
4-Way Stop on County Road XX and Terrebonne Drive
Resolution 2026-011 Establishing a Temporary Moratorium on New Data Center Development Applications and Referring the Matter to the Planning and Utility Committees for Further Study
2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget – 1st Draft as of 07/31/2026

discussions.item: 4-Way Stop on County Road XX and Terrebonne Drive
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and potentially take action on the installation of a four-way stop at the intersection of County Road XX and Terrebonne Drive. This item was listed under old business, indicating it was a continuation of previous deliberations.
The committee was set to discuss and potentially take action on an oak wilt ordinance. This ordinance was expected to address management and prevention of oak wilt disease in the village.

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-011 Establishing a Temporary Moratorium on New Data Center Development Applications and Referring the Matter to the Planning and Utility Committees for Further Study
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to consider a resolution establishing a temporary moratorium on new data center development applications in Kronenwetter and referring the matter to the Planning and Utility Committees for further study. This action was expected to provide time for the village to evaluate data center development policies.

The committee was set to discuss potential future trails in Kronenwetter as part of the village's recreational infrastructure planning. This item was expected to explore trail development opportunities for the community.

discussions.item: 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget – 1st Draft as of 07/31/2026
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review the first draft of the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget. This multi-year budget was expected to outline planned capital projects and infrastructure investments for the village over the ten-year period.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, with a 15-minute total period and three-minute individual time limit per person.
